note: Deep-dive #7. Order: policy-portal, calls, topic, worker. The calls screen holds take 1 and, after a 65 s pause, take 2 (rate limit): take 2 replays PR-1002's idempotency key so Service Bus duplicate detection drops it and the topic counts shown in the next screen stay 2 and 1 (deviation from demo.md's PR-2000 loop, which would add 25 messages).
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded
$ids = ./apim/entra/New-GatewayApps.ps1   # prints tenantId, apiClientId, callerClientId; secret stays in $env:PURCHASE_CALLER_SECRET
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-07 -l westeurope -o none

az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-07 -f infra/main.bicep -p "apiClientId=$($ids.apiClientId)" "publisherEmail=$(az ad signed-in-user show --query userPrincipalName -o tsv)" "receiverPrincipalId=$(az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv)" --query properties.outputs -o json > $env:TEMP\apim-outputs.json
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignments can take about five minutes
Send-PurchaseEvent -GatewayUrl $env:MG_GATEWAY_URL -SubscriptionKey $env:APIM_KEY -Token $token -PurchaseRequestId PR-9001 -Total 10 | Select-Object StatusCode   # smoke call, expect 202
dotnet run --project src/PurchaseEvents.Worker -- --namespace $env:MG_SB_FQDN --topic purchase-events --subscription all-events --max-messages 1   # drain the smoke message so counts start from zero
Start-Sleep -Seconds 65   # quiet minute before the rate-limit take

az ad app delete --id $env:MG_CALLER_CLIENT; az ad app delete --id $env:MG_API_CLIENT
Remove-Item Env:APIM_KEY, Env:PURCHASE_CALLER_SECRET, Env:MG_GATEWAY_URL, Env:MG_SB_FQDN, Env:MG_APIM07, Env:MG_TENANT_ID, Env:MG_API_CLIENT, Env:MG_CALLER_CLIENT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
